statement: In the frozen simultaneous-switch normal form F_j=G R_j, P_{A_0}=G B, B=R_j Q_j, P_{A_j}=F_0 Q_j, with F_j=P_{lambda_j X}, the common-X scalar-copy structure belongs to F_j and not to the generally signed quotient Q_j. The data define no family Q_j(T) and hence no expression Q_j(lambda_j X) or coefficient Jacobian of that expression. Therefore the proposed implication from factor-labelled moments of Q_j (M1083R2-01) to the advertised common-X Jacobian (M1083R2-05) is ill-typed unless a new compatible parametrization is supplied. Replacing Q_j by F_j repairs the type but the inherited divisibility G|F_j and Newton-direction argument already yield the reciprocal chart on t^(5/9-o(1)) rows, so the only remaining exponent-changing step is the M1083R2-10 actual distance-label inequality.
dependency_gaps: M1083R2-01 needs a precisely defined factor-labelled invariant and a conclusion not already supplied by the heavy-factor hub.
Any repaired M1083R2-05 route needs an explicit bounded-degree family Q(T), proof that Q(lambda_j)=Q_j, and t^o(1) control of symmetries and singular fibres.
M1083R2-10 still needs a collision-controlled theorem amplifying t^(5/9-o(1)) chart parameters to more than t^(3+epsilon) actual labels; chart distinctness alone is short by exponent 22/9.
Outer near-extremal stability remains outside the exact-block chain.
